text:
Tara: Heads up — RiverOak dropped ~68% active calls last 14d after their new CTO joined and kicked off a trial with CompetitorX. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Jack saw this in the usage dashboard. Can we triage now?

Jack: yep saw it. Their champion (Nina) moved to a new role last week, CTO is evaluating latency and cost. Competitor pilot started 2 weeks ago. Noted reduced traffic from their analytics service.

Leo: quick datapoint from the integration logs — token volume for their main route fell from ~12k/day to ~4k/day on 3/8. Also a spike in 503s around 3/6 when they increased seq_len.

Oliver: I looked at the infra traces — we had a short kv-cache eviction pattern on 3/6 for that tenant (misconfigured batching on dedicated pool). Should be fixable with a config toggle.

Tara: thanks. proposed immediate playbook: 1) schedule technical Q/A w/ CTO + ENG this week, 2) offer a targeted perf tuning session and a temporary priority lane, 3) propose a 6-week pilot extension with a usage credit tied to SLA improvements, 4) prepare a renewal health brief for execs. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Maria: agree. I'll prep the renewal health brief and run the pricing impact for a 6-week credit. If we offer credit, recommend tying it to measurable latency and token-rate KPIs.

Jack: can someone run an enablement/ops session for their platform engineers? CTO asked for a short workshop on cost-optimization and batching. Leo or Oliver?

Leo: I can lead the workshop tomorrow afternoon. Will demo batching + prefix caching and show before/after perf.

Oliver: I'll deploy the kv-cache tweak to a canary for their tenant and monitor over 24h. If stable, roll to production.

Tara: assign owners: Leo = enablement/workshop, Oliver = canary patch, Maria = renewal brief & pricing, Jack = exec outreach & competitor intel. I'll own coord + QBR scheduling.

Jack: pinging Nina and CTO tomorrow. Also pulling the competitor feature list to map gaps.

Maria: attaching quick snapshot in the thread:```
usage_last_14d: 4,200 calls/day
usage_prev_14d: 13,000 calls/day
errors_3-6: 9% (503s)
latency_p50_pre: 220ms -> p50_post: 390ms
```

Tara: scheduler-bot, can you propose 3 windows for a 60-min technical Q/A with RiverOak (include Leo + Oliver + Jack + Tara)? :calendar:

scheduler-bot: Proposed slots sent to RiverOak contacts (tomorrow 15:00, Thu 10:00, Fri 11:30). Waiting for confirmation. :white_check_mark:

Jack: thanks team. Goal: prevent churn by fixing perf + running a short enablement + showing measurable improvement before renewal conversation. I'll update after outreach. :muscle:
